description: Shared behavior-parity fixture for the artist splitter. Consumed by BOTH scripts/splitter_parity_harness.mjs (which runs the canonical TS splitArtistCollab from the built crawler dist) and scripts/test_splitter_behavior_parity.py (which runs the Python artist_components_for_drop_check mirror). Each `input` is fed to both implementations; the test asserts the two produce the SAME set of drop-check keys (normalizeForMatch applied to every component). See test_splitter_behavior_parity.py for the full comparison-contract rationale. Add a case here whenever a new delimiter, edge form, or invariant needs cross-language protection.

cases.note: feat-paren + scoped ' of ' member-of-group sub-split (fires INSIDE the paren only)
feat-paren ' of ' sub-split emits both member and group
(Prod.X) producer credit is structurally identical to (Feat.X)

cases.input: Charlie Puth(Feat.宇多田ヒカル) & Adele
cases.note: mid-string feat paren plus a top-level & delimiter
two feat/prod parentheticals joined by a top-level & — each paren contributes its inner as a component
bare ' of ' OUTSIDE any feat/prod paren must NOT split (real band name)
another bare ' of ' non-split guard
bare ' of ' at top level does NOT split (only fires inside feat/prod parens)
ampersand plus un-parenthesized 'feat.' delimiter in one string
ASCII ampersand delimiter
full-width ampersand U+FF06 (split runs before NFKC)
comma delimiter, three components
multiplication sign U+00D7 delimiter
full-width vertical bar U+FF5C delimiter (blog collab convention)
full-width pipe with CJK operands
ASCII pipe | is NOT a delimiter — must round-trip unchanged
' meets ' delimiter (CHiCO with HoneyWorks meets ...)

cases.input: CHiCO with HoneyWorks meets 中川翔子
cases.note: chained ' with ' and ' meets ' delimiters

cases.input: 安室奈美恵 with スーパーモンキーズ
cases.note: ' with ' delimiter, whitespace-delimited so it never bites mid-word
IGNORECASE: upper-case FEAT. must split like feat.
IGNORECASE lower-case control for the FEAT. case above
IGNORECASE: upper-case WITH must split like ' with '
IGNORECASE: upper-case MEETS must split like ' meets '
case-variant components collapse to one drop-check key under NFKC+lowercase
single artist round-trips unchanged
empty string yields no components on both sides
whitespace-only string yields no components on both sides
